# Allerby Fish Hatchery - records workspace

Working area for the hatchery office.

- records/  the unit each hatchery reading is recorded in

The unit of a reading is fixed by the hatchery's operating manual and the sheet is edited in place, so a reading is never recorded in two units. Entries are kept in the order the readings were added to the record sheet. Last reviewed 2026-02-26, reference AH-9963.
